title: Parkland C1: The lantern pavilion, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Parkland C1 (The lantern pavilion). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): The paper lantern was the Expo's first exhibit, and it is lit again for the visitors. Arms 1 is fitted; Farsight calls it safety equipment. Under the footbridge, push off one car into the next.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): The paper lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit again for our clients. Arms 1 is fitted: under the footbridge, push off one car into the next, and the Expo opens safer.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
